summary: Held through repeated ~15-30% givebacks (and even a couple deeper ones early on) because the trend kept making new favorable highs with positive lambda and rising ER10 -- consistent with the graveyard finding that cutting winners early loses to the heavy right tail. Exited at +54.25pts when three things stacked at once: ER10 collapsed to 0.00 (no trend efficiency left), the 1m lambda_hat flipped decisively negative (t=-2.3, -1.8) after being persistently positive the entire ride, and both KMDR and PROPP fired against in the same window -- the classic lambda-completion exhaustion signature. Next time I'd watch for this same triple-stack (ER10->0, lambda sign-flip with |t|>2, multiple against-fires) as the primary reversal trigger rather than giveback% alone, since giveback recovered from much worse levels (66%, 103%) earlier without this signature present.
